department: School of Mechanical and Mining Engineering

deadline.value: The UQ International Round closed 19 October 2026; the next round is not stated on the pages checked.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: UQ requires a thesis supervisor to be found before applying.
supervisor.quote: You have to find a thesis supervisor before you apply.

funding.value: UQ awards a limited number of scholarships each year, so funding is competitive.
funding.quote: Each year, we award more than 600 scholarships to attract and support the highest quality higher degree by research applicants.

entry_route.value: A research master's or a bachelor's with honours class IIA or equivalent is accepted, so a direct bachelor's entry is possible.
entry_route.quote: Master of Philosophy (or another research master's degree); or

also.quote: Bachelor's degree from an approved university with at least honours class IIA or equivalent

notes: The school study page points applicants to Study at UQ and states no separate PhD rule.
